title: Skip Badaling: 10 Million Tourists a Year — Walk This Wall Instead | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone photographs Badaling. Here's why I'd send you to Mutianyu instead.

Badaling is the closest restored section to Beijing, so it pulls the biggest crowds — over 10 million visitors a year, roughly three times the footfall at Mutianyu. Mutianyu is the longest fully restored stretch open to tourists, with 23 original-style watchtowers, a cable car up and a toboggan run back down. For a first China trip, that trade — a little more travel time for a lot less crowd — is the one I'd make.

🧭 Expert Tip: Do Mutianyu on a weekday morning and ride the cable car up — you'll be on the wall before the tour buses from Badaling even arrive.
